screens.name: Home — empty omen and populated omen; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show the illustrated hero, both omen states and matching transitions; supplied evidence reports responsive layouts and stopped motion.
findings: Give the faint example question above the orb a steadier readable treatment without competing with the hero.

screens.name: Approach loading; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 pairs the opening state and transition, while supplied motion evidence reports an immediate reduced-motion approach.
findings: Preserve the clear next-step hint and verify that an unexpectedly stalled opening receives recovery guidance.

screens.name: Ask composer — self, normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 02 and 04 show the labeled question field and submit action, with supplied checks covering scaling, retention and keyboard operation.
findings: Reduce the enlarged composer’s vertical overhead so the submit action is easier to discover below the disclosure.

screens.name: Named-person editor — selected and enlarged; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–04 show explicit person modes, name and save/cancel controls; supplied evidence reports validation and preserved identity drafts.
findings: Keep Cancel readily discoverable at enlarged text, where it falls below the initial viewport.

screens.name: Ask composer — saved person, normal and enlarged; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 03 and 20–21 show the retained question and Alex identity, and supplied evidence reports that the saved identity reaches the actual request.
findings: Shorten the large empty field area after a short question to bring submission closer to the entered content.

screens.name: Adaptive card 1; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show the first question and four answer rows; supplied evidence reports single keyboard advancement and answer retention.
findings: Use answer labels on a consistent scale, since 'Halfway there' and 'Nearly certain' describe different properties.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the second question, restrained progress marker and generously separated answer rows.
findings: Include a captured selected or pressed answer state to substantiate feedback quality beyond the resting rows.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show the final question with consistent progress, spacing and custom-answer access.
findings: Show the final-answer handoff in interaction evidence to verify continuity into forecast loading.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows a focused multiline field and disabled Continue, with supplied evidence reporting retained question and navigation at 200%.
findings: Rename 'Choices' to 'Back to choices' so the escape from free text is immediately explicit.

screens.name: Voice unavailable; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a prominent typing fallback, voice retry and explanatory notice; supplied browser evidence reports working fallback.
findings: Keep the microphone failure explanation near the retry action so the cause and recovery remain visually connected.

screens.name: Planning loading; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows task-specific loading text, expected duration and Cancel; supplied evidence reports timeout and credit-preserving recovery.
findings: Retain the duration and credit reassurance when testing this layout with enlarged text and an on-screen keyboard.

screens.name: Research loading; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 show research-specific progress copy and cancellation, with consistent imagery across transition captures.
findings: Verify that assistive technology announces the change from planning to research once without repeated ambient announcements.

screens.name: Planning error; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 07–08 show failure, no-charge reassurance, retry and question editing; supplied evidence reports successful retry without lost credits.
findings: Preserve this focused recovery hierarchy when replacing the explicitly labeled fixture with actual failure details.

screens.name: Prediction error; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 adds Review answers to retry and edit recovery, while supplied evidence reports preserved answers and credits.
findings: Verify that returning from answer review restores the failed request context and its recovery focus.

screens.name: Sensitive-question redirect — planning and prediction; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows support, alternative-question and edit actions plus explicit credit and memory reassurance.
findings: Place the short explanation before the support button so users understand the destination before acting.

screens.name: Forecast reveal; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show the forecast, qualification, date, Why and follow-up actions; supplied evidence distinguishes synthetic layout text from actual reading checks.
findings: Label the displayed date as either the forecast deadline or check-in date to distinguish it from time language inside the forecast.

screens.name: Forecast check-in; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows three outcome responses below the forecast and above sharing.
findings: Give the outcome question slightly stronger separation from the sharing action so recording an outcome reads as its own task.

screens.name: Saved outcomes — yes, not quite and pending
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show checked selections, persistent saved labels and confirmation notices; supplied evidence reports persisted outcomes.
findings: Keep the pending confirmation from covering follow-up controls, using the same clear spacing as the other saved states.

screens.name: Evidence overview — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 21 and 23 show four explicit evidence categories, with supplied checks reporting complete content and keyboard navigation.
findings: Make the repeated forecast more compact at 200% so it does not push most evidence categories below the first viewport.

screens.name: Evidence answers reader — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 and 19–20 show the answer reader, with supplied evidence reporting complete passages, heading focus and return navigation.
findings: Keep each answer associated with its original question when that information is available, rather than relying on terse section identifiers.

screens.name: Evidence assumptions reader — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 09 and 20 show a quiet assumptions reader and visible navigation, with supplied full-content and focus checks.
findings: Preserve the complete passage while testing long authored paragraphs for comfortable reading at enlarged text.

screens.name: Evidence reasoning reader — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 and 21–22 show separated full passages, while supplied evidence reports lossless text and focus return.
findings: Use authored paragraph boundaries consistently to make long reasoning easier to scan without inventing headings or omitting text.

screens.name: Free Why reader — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 24 shows explicit Back to forecast at both sizes, and supplied current navigation checks report hidden forecast actions and restored trigger focus.
findings: Retain the explicit Back action and quiet background as the standard pattern for focused reading.

screens.name: Evidence sources reader — normal and enlarged; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 10 and 22 show publisher, date, full fixture title and Open source, with supplied evidence reporting complete reachable titles.
findings: Bring source-opening access closer to publisher and date so very long titles do not bury the action.

screens.name: Share — collapsed and expanded options; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 27–28 show preview, download, privacy explanation and expandable options; supplied evidence reports real PNG export and keyboard return.
findings: Avoid leaving a thin clipped remnant of the page title beneath the fixed header when the options view is scrolled.

screens.name: Export preparing
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows disabled preparation and repeated status text, with supplied evidence identifying this as retained held-export proof.
findings: Use one prominent preparation message and reserve the separate status area for meaningful progress or failure.

screens.name: Export failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows export failure immediately below the download button, and supplied evidence reports injected failure and successful retry.
findings: Change the failed-state button label to 'Try download again' to make recovery explicit.

screens.name: Shared image inspection — normal and enlarged; transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–29 show the full-width composition and transcript entry, with supplied evidence reporting exact accessible text and focus return.
findings: Keep the scalable transcript easy to discover because enlarging interface text does not enlarge lettering inside the raster image.

screens.name: History — empty; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a clear empty-state invitation, local-storage explanation and persistent navigation.
findings: Give 'Ask the Ball' a slightly stronger action treatment within the otherwise expansive empty state.

screens.name: History — populated, stress and persisted outcome; transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show dated rows, check-back dates and saved outcome markings; supplied evidence reports history and outcome persistence.
findings: Format check-back dates in the same readable month style used by the forecast view.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples and selected question; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 28 explicitly labels offline samples and shows a checked star with its corresponding question and action.
findings: Verify generous hit areas and a predictable keyboard order for the scattered star controls.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 explains offline availability beside disabled creation and eligibility controls, with supplied current capture evidence confirming both explanations.

screens.name: Plans — yearly selected, packs and enlarged; transition

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation; transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows two explicit age choices and no birthday requirement, with supplied evidence reporting acceptance, decline and reload gating.

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday; transition

screens.evidence: Sheets 01 and 15 show readable restriction and correction access at both sizes, with supplied evidence reporting focus, contrast and persistent gating.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected, selected and enlarged; transitions

screens.name: Optional birth-details form — normal and enlarged; transition

screens.name: Settings — empty memory, controls and enlarged

components.name: Tab bar

findings: Keep labels comfortably separated at 200% and verify complete target rectangles around the small peripheral icons.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header

findings: Use an opaque, clean scroll boundary so moving content does not leave partial text beneath the header.

components.name: Primary button

findings: Provide representative pressed and focused captures to complete the demonstrated button-state set.

components.name: Secondary action

components.name: Answer choice

components.name: Question input

components.name: Settings switch

components.name: Omen content

components.name: Sky stars and selected question

components.name: Circle surface

components.name: History row

components.name: Birthday input

components.name: Age confirmation

findings: Verify close-control naming and hit areas consistently across every full-screen variant.

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments using attached screenshots and supplied runtime summaries; no raw checks or live interactions were independently rerun.
Scores use the full browser range without a blanket deduction for deferred native proof; the supplied evidence does not establish premium outcomes for every component.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
The authorized every-item A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met; strong visual coherence does not erase specific readability, hierarchy and recovery limitations.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied material; content extending below a screenshot is not treated as unreachable when supplied layout evidence reports reachability.
The clipped enlarged birthday example is a visible defect, but other date-format guidance remains visible, so it does not establish an essential-content hard-gate failure.
Paired transition images support visual consistency but cannot independently establish continuous animation, focus timing, absence of intermediate shifts or response latency.
Several supplied checks are retained from earlier rounds and have not been independently reconfirmed here; their stated provenance is preserved.
Synthetic forecasts, repeated passages, source titles and fixture labels are assessed as layout stress material, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text scaling, microphone, haptics, real payments and OS sharing remain unverified and receive no certification.
Offline Circles and sampled Sky are demonstrated states; configured production social services, permissions and authentication are not established by these screenshots.
Pressed controls, some validation variants, city search results and keyboard-open layouts are not comprehensively pictured; runtime summaries support only the specific behaviors they describe.
Raster share-image text is not covered by DOM contrast checks; the supplied transcript and enlargement evidence mitigate access without proving raster readability at every delivery size.
topFixes: Fix the clipped 200% birthday example and give impossible dates a calendar-specific validation message.
Reduce enlarged heading and summary overhead in composers, onboarding, evidence overview, plans and birth details while preserving full text scaling.
Label forecast dates explicitly and distinguish the role of a forecast deadline from a check-in date.
Clean up partially clipped text at fixed-header boundaries in Settings and expanded Share.
Make navigation and recovery labels exact: Back to choices, navigation-style Why, and Try download again.
Complete browser evidence for pressed states, city lookup recovery, keyboard-open layouts and notice placement before claiming every component reaches 9.
